For the $y$ pattern, we subtract $9$ from each row.

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{21}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{21} - \goldE{3}=\maroonE{18}\\\\

Pattern $y$: Subtract $\tealE{9}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{63}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{63} - \tealE{9}=\maroonE{54}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{54} - \tealE{9}=\purpleD{45}\end{align}$
